lead: Climate change continues to impact ecosystems, economies, and technological innovations, with recent studies highlighting its effects on coral physiology and extreme weather patterns.

stories.title: Tiny Hairs That Help Corals Breathe May Malfunction in Warming Oceans
stories.summary: Recent studies reveal that tiny hairs on corals, crucial for their respiration, may fail in increasingly warm oceans. This malfunction could jeopardize coral survival and the broader marine ecosystems they support. Understanding these physiological changes is essential as climate change accelerates.

stories.title: It Still Feels Like Summer in Parts of the US. Blame El Niño
stories.summary: Parts of the US are experiencing unseasonably warm temperatures, attributed to the El Niño climate pattern combined with ongoing fossil fuel emissions. This phenomenon is leading to record-breaking heat, raising concerns about the long-term impacts of climate change on seasonal weather patterns.

stories.title: Meet the innovators under 35 shaping climate tech
stories.summary: MIT Technology Review highlights nine young innovators under 35 who are making significant strides in climate technology. These individuals are developing solutions to combat climate change, showcasing the potential of fresh perspectives and innovative ideas in addressing environmental challenges.

stories.title: The Download: mice with part-human brains and climate tech innovators
stories.summary: This edition of The Download covers a range of topics, including groundbreaking research on mice with part-human brains and the latest advancements in climate technology. The intersection of biology and tech is paving the way for innovative solutions to climate-related issues.

stories.title: The best workplace culture in America is being built by companies you’ve never heard of
stories.summary: As large corporations face layoffs and a shift in corporate culture driven by AI, small and mid-sized businesses are emerging as leaders in workplace culture. These companies are prioritizing employee well-being and sustainable practices, reflecting a broader trend towards valuing human contributions in the face of climate challenges.
